about: Researched first-posting dates for cities that were already open at this tracker's first check (20 Nov 2026). Hand-curated; never written by the refresh scripts. A date is the earliest credible evidence that the role was up in that city, so it's an upper bound on the real posting date. kind: x-post / news / aggregator / archive count as confirmed; id-batch, id-interpolation and ambiguous-post are estimates.
notTried: Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) refused connections from our research machine on 24 Nov 2026, so per-job archive captures couldn't be checked this time. The archived careers snapshots we already had stop at May 2025, before any Robotaxi supervisor role existed.

idCalibration.note: Tesla job ids grow roughly in order. Anchors with dated evidence, mid 2026: about 106 new ids a day. Only used where no direct evidence exists.
